calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year LIKE 'FY202%'
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
LIMIT 50

SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period = 5

SELECT DISTINCT vat_rate
FROM fact_sales_line
ORDER BY vat_rate

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.vat_rate,
    COUNT(*) as line_count,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net,
    SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) as vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

SELECT 
    f.vat_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) as vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.vat_rate IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_vat_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.vat_rate NOT IN (0.10, 0.14, 0.24, 0.255) THEN 1 END) as unexpected_vat_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'

SELECT 
    f.channel_code,
    COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY f.channel_code

SELECT 
    ROUND(f.vat_rate * 100, 2) as vat_rate_percent,
    ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) as vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

SELECT 
    ROUND(f.vat_rate * 100, 2) as vat_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) as vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 5
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate
